newIntro: Each tenant runs in its own container with its own database and files. Memberships are user claims: tenant={{slug}} for users and tenant-admin={{slug}} for administrators; both need role=osiris-user.
quotasHint: An empty field means no limit (storage: 80% of the disk). Members see usage above the tenant in the sidebar.
noBackups: None yet. A backup is made before every sleep and daily.
reset2faHint: For a user who lost the phone with the authenticator app and the recovery codes
inviteHint: A new user gets a one-time sign-in link. Membership changes apply within a minute.
removeHint: Removes the tenant from every user's claims, so nobody from the tenant can sign in any more. The container stops; the disk and backups are kept.
webSitesHint: Sites from Traffic the tenant sees on its Websites dashboard (one per line, for example k6labs.cz). It always sees the sites of its own domains.
